clips.title: The story
paras: Commander Althea Ebonlocke has a torn, bloodstained journal page examined during the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. A few words remain legible, and she asks Clerk Daltry to compare the handwriting with the Town Registry.

Commander Althea Ebonlocke watches over Darkshire and asks that the handwriting on a torn, bloodstained page be examined. Though thick blood covers it, a few words remain legible for Clerk Daltry to compare with the Town Registry.
